Unscheduled items in the window: a named 14A foundry customer (CEO Lip-Bu Tan said a couple are ready to announce in the next two quarters, src 9), Fab 28 restart news (src 10), and semis sector swings (INTC fell 7% on 2026-11-16 with 33 of 34 large semis, src 17). Post-earnings drift after the October 30 guide-down (-28.6%, src 17) and the CEO's $9.7M open-market buy at $64.73 (src 18) pull in opposite directions, so I keep the median at today's $59.66 with a symmetric lognormal of 21% monthly vol, a little below the 86% annual realized / 3.5 = 24.6% because the post-crash spike is fading.

fair_value.method: Driver build (PC TAM x client revenue per unit, supply-limited DCAI, foundry loss) gives FY2028-weighted NTM GAAP EPS ~$1.48 at the horizon; x 42.0x (k=0.8 shrink of INTC's 53.0x toward the 22.4x peer median, less 2.6 turns for long-dated risks) = $62.14, weight 0.75; normalized mid-cycle EPS $1.217 x 22.4x = $27.25, weight 0.25; blend $53.42.

downside.story: P10: PC TAM falls ~15% in 2027 as memory costs bite deeper (vs our -10%), Intel loses client share (RPU -3%), DCAI shipments 7% lower (Fab 28 recovery slips, substrate relief late, AMD share gains), DCAI and client margins 2-3 pts lower, foundry loss $1B wider with no anchor 14A customer; the market de-rates INTC by 10 turns toward peers. ~$25.8.

base.story: Median: PCs fall ~10% again in 2027 and client margins compress; DCAI grows ~23% on supply-limited Xeon; the foundry loss narrows to $7.0B then $5.5B; INTC keeps a premium P/E (42x) on recovering EPS of ~$1.48 but gives back some of it.

upside.story: P90: PC TAM recovers faster (memory relief in H2 2027), DCAI shipments 10% higher on earlier substrate and 18A/Intel 3 capacity, allocation pricing holds (+3 pts), a named 14A anchor customer with prepayments cuts the foundry loss by $2B, and the multiple holds 12 turns above our base. ~$104.9.

sbc_treatment.note: GAAP EBIT after SBC (F36 FY2025 $2,434M; TTM $2,432M F39); peers on Zacks EPS after SBC (peers.md note); share count still grows +1%/yr for SBC issuance with no buybacks.

reasoning: Skeptic lane. What went wrong since the $142 high: Q3 2026 beat (revenue $16.5B, non-GAAP EPS $0.52) but the Q4 guide ($15-16B, 38% non-GAAP GM) reset client hard (CCPG down >20% q/q) on a memory-cost PC slump IDC measured at -20.1% in Q3 after a first-half channel pull-in, plus a deadly Fab 28 explosion that costs ~$600M of server revenue over two quarters; stock -28.6% on Oct 30, BofA and Roth downgraded, targets cut to $70-100, and a class action now alleges Intel hid PC channel inventory. Accounting flags: GAAP results are noisy (Q2 GAAP EPS -$2.16 on escrowed-share marks, $4.07B Mobileye impairment in Q1), the share count rose from 4,530M to 5,307M in a year through government, SoftBank, Nvidia and an Aug 2026 $95 offering, and NCI (fab JVs) takes ~$0.8B a year of earnings that per-share P/E screens miss. Weighed honestly: net cash of $3.9B, DCAI +78% y/y and supply-limited into 2028, and the CEO's $9.7M open-market buy at $64.73 argue against a collapse. My build sits below consensus (FY2027 EPS ~$1.06 vs Zacks $1.31) on a 10% 2027 PC decline (Intel's own plan, more cautious than IDC) and a slower foundry-loss path. Value: own NTM P/E 53x shrunk toward the 22.4x peer median (k=0.8, 44.6x) less 2.6 turns for long-dated risks = 42x on horizon EPS ~$1.48 = $62.14, blended 75/25 with a normalized $1.217 x 22.4x = $27.25 cross-check: $53.42 research target (12m), -10% vs $59.66. P10 $25.80 / P90 $104.91 from driver moves plus +/-10-12 turns, wide because realized vol is 86%. Research was limited: the shared web-fetch budget ran out before credit-rating and short-interest pages could be opened, so no current rating or CDS level is used; sell-side notes are not public, so downgrades are cited through a Stocktwits relay. Not driver-linked: the normalized custom leg.

custom.name: Normalized mid-cycle EPS x through-cycle P/E
custom.explanation: Normalized-earnings cross-check (playbook 0.2-0.4): FY2028 revenue $69.07B (engine) x 12.5% mid-cycle GAAP operating margin = $8.63B, less $0.95B NCI = $7.68B x (1 - 15%) = $6.53B / 5,368.5M shares at the horizon = $1.217 x 22.4x peer-median NTM P/E as the through-cycle multiple = $27.25. model_inputs.structure_note: Annual driver-led set (7 drivers: PC TAM, client revenue per unit, client margin, DCAI revenue, DCAI margin, foundry loss, corporate+NCI). Value is carried by the P/E leg (75%) on the build's own NTM GAAP EPS at the horizon (FY2028-weighted) and a normalized mid-cycle EPS x through-cycle P/E cross-check (25%). No DCF (semis). No FCF-yield leg: forward FCF margin is below 2% in FY2026-27 (FCFF -1.1B and -1.6B on the engine rows) because gross capex rises strongly in 2027, so the tech FCF-leg rule does not apply. EV legs are not used, so minorities enter only through EPS (corp_other driver). Not quarterly: this agent pass is annual for time; the supervisor may roll it to quarters.
model_inputs.gap_note: Judgment calls for Kilian: (1) exit P/E 42.0x = k-rule 44.6x less 2.6 turns for net long-dated risks (long_dated_risks); without the haircut the research target (12m) is $56.30 (+5.4%), so this is a card candidate. (2) Normalized leg weight 0.25 and 12.5% mid-cycle margin; at weight 0 the target is $62.14. (3) Financing below the 20% bar: a further equity raise by Nov 2027 (~15%; Intel sold 242M shares at $95 in Aug 2026 and 2027 capex rises strongly, but cash + ST investments were $54.0B at 2026-09-26, F80+F81). (4) Not modeled: Intel's 49% Altera stake (equity method) and IMS stake (would add roughly $0.5-1/share), US government warrants for 5% at $20 exercisable only if Intel gives up foundry control (~10%). (5) Net cash at the horizon earns nothing in the annual engine (conservative by ~$0.01/share). (6) Annual set: non-operating income (interest income $1,128M YTD, F96) is not carried as its own line (rule 29 applies to quarterly sets); with net cash at the horizon this understates EPS slightly. (7) Engine-sized alternatives that move the target >5%: DCAI margin held at 41.5% (+$13.22), a foundry breakeven path (+$26.25), Q3 run-rate foundry loss (-$8.77), DCAI flat in FY2028 (-$5.37).
